page_data.syllabus:
ডেন্টাল পার্টের পরীক্ষা – ২৮ 
 General Anatomy + Physiology + Biochemistry 
 (Anatomy: Definition, subdivisions of Anatomy and its importance in the study of dental course Anatomical terminology and anatomical planes & positions. Skeletal system- Bones-classification, composition, functions, parts of a developing long bone, blood supply, periosteum & endosteum. Ossification- definition, centres & processes. Factors affecting growth of bone
 Cartilages- composition, types, characters, locations and functions. Joint: Definition, Component parts, classification, characteristics of each type & movements, stability of the joints. General plan of blood supply & nerve supply of joints. Muscular system: classification, characteristics and functions Blood vascular system: component parts
 Nutrition & innervation of vessels. Vascular anastomosis Nervous system. Lymphoid organs classification & functions. Endocrine system: Component parts, situation, functions. Special sense organs: parts & functions.
 Human Cell: types, basic organization, constituents. Cell membrane Cytoplasm, organelles and inclusions. nucleus: Chromosomes: structure, classification, biochemical nature & chromosomal disorders (Down Syndrome, Turner's Syndrome, Klinefelter's syndrome) Gene, genotype and phenotype: definition
 Physiology & Biochemistry: Transport processes across the plasma membrane, resting membrane potential, action potentials. Muscle contraction and relaxation. The function of heart and circulatory system. Respiratory processes with the knowledge of structures, ventilation, diffusion, blood flow, gas transport, mechanics of breathing and control of ventilation. Mechanism of work of the brain at the neuronal systems level. Autonomic nervous system and special sense. Function of endocrine physiology. Knowledge and understanding of biochemistry in medicine and surgery. Biomolecules forming the structure of the human body, their functions and their role in health and diseases.) 
 Role of enzymes in the diagnosis of diseases. Metabolic reactions in the body. Role of liver in the body. Mechanism of maintenance of homeostasis by regulating both the composition and volume of ECF compartment by the kidney. 
 Water and electrolyte content of human body and their functions. Types, causes and consequences of dehydration and over hydration. Causes and the consequences of electrolyte imbalance. 
 Sources of acids and bases in our body and the mechanism of their normal balance. causes and consequences of acidosis and alkalosis and the parameters to diagnose them. 
 Diabetes mellitus, impairment of renal, liver and thyroid functions.
